column1: # The XDP kernel tier's pinned matrix. run.sh fetches each artifact once into
# its work directory, refuses any whose sha256 differs from the pinned value,
# and never boots a refused kernel.
# name: the matrix column. version: the kernel release the guest reports in
# uname -r. kind: deb-image and deb-modules are a distribution's prebuilt
# packages, extracted without root; source is a kernel.org tarball built
# with vng --build inside the work directory; tool is the pinned virtme-ng
# release, installed with --require-hashes into a virtualenv inside the work
# directory when the machine has no vng.
# The distribution kernel is the game server machine's kernel. The longterm
# kernel is the newest longterm release kernel.org listed on 2026-10-15; its
# sha256 is the one kernel.org's sha256sums.asc published for the tarball.
# The virtme-ng release is the newest one at least two weeks old on that day.
